title: Alphadome Open Brain — phase and KPI registry
thesis: The auditable operations brain for commerce in emerging markets: proof over promise, evidence over claims, human approval at every irreversible step.

doctrine.measure: 10 random outputs audited monthly; 0 without an evidence ref

doctrine.rule: Every irreversible action waits for a human
doctrine.measure: 0 price-bearing actions without an approval row (test + DB constraint)

doctrine.rule: Every tenant boundary is proven, not promised
Every claim is reproducible by a stranger
doctrine.measure: node scripts/open_brain_evidence.mjs regenerates the pack in under 2 minutes

doctrine.rule: Every system has an off switch and a rollback
doctrine.measure: AI_JOBS_MULTITENANT off returns 404 on tenant routes; every migration ships a _ROLLBACK.sql

doctrine.rule: Every metric is extreme-tested before it is optimized
doctrine.measure: every KPI in this registry has a kill criterion and a target
one recorded adversarial hour per week; failures appended to the risk register

phases.name: Name the brain and package the proof
phases.target_buyer: International agency or consultancy evaluating a white-label licence (secondary: Kenyan SME via /discovery)
phases.workflow: Prove the stack is isolated, metered and real before signing a licence
phases.slice: One buyer-facing /open-brain page plus a one-command evidence pack generator, built only from artifacts that already exist
phases.revenue_impact: Turns the published $10,000 licence anchor into a demonstration; target 3 agency conversations
risks: Publishing a claim the tests no longer support (mitigate: generate numbers from suite output)
Isolation proof currently 1 pass / 3 skipped (mitigate: fill the data gaps, do not reframe them)
objectives: Make the evidence pack regenerable by a stranger
Publish the position without breaking the landing contract
tasks: Populate brand_id, submissions and user_credits so all four probe checks execute
Re-run npm run proof:isolation and npm run proof:isolation:live:auto; commit 4/4
Add scripts/open_brain_evidence.mjs
Build public/open-brain.html with Live/Demo/Next labels and JSON-LD Service
Extend npm run test:landing to cover the new page
Record a 4-minute proof-first demo
exit_criteria: A stranger reproduces the proof and the pack without the founder on the call
kill_criteria: Three agency calls and nobody reads the pack: stop polishing and sell the quotation slice instead

phases.name: Wire the senses, expose the memory
phases.target_buyer: Existing paying tenant who cannot answer 'what did the brain do for me this week?'
phases.workflow: Activity accountability: one tenant-scoped screen showing what was sensed, decided, sent and paid
phases.slice: A read-only v_brain_activity view over existing per-domain tables plus one timeline panel in the tenant dashboard. No new write path
phases.revenue_impact: Renewal artefact and the first thing an agency audit asks for; reduces churn
risks: View leaking across tenants (mitigate: session-scoped route plus offline test that tenant cannot be spoofed)
Slow joins on a growing log (mitigate: 90-day window on the existing index)
objectives: One screen proves the brain's week without SQL
tasks: Inventory the six inbound surfaces with table, tenant key and populated status
Add migrations/2026-12-01_brain_activity_view.sql plus rollback
Add GET /tenant/open-brain/activity behind tenantSessionAuth
Render the timeline panel in admin/tenant_dashboard.html
Add scripts/test_open_brain_activity.mjs
Backfill brand_id on historical bot_tenants rows

kpis.metric: Cross-tenant rows visible in the isolation probe
Time to answer 'what did it do yesterday?'

exit_criteria: A pilot tenant opens the panel unprompted and cites it when renewing
kill_criteria: Tenants look once and never return: stop building surfaces and return to P2 revenue work

phases.name: Reasoning that ships paid work: quotation and tender intelligence
phases.target_buyer: Kenyan contractor, supplier or professional-services firm losing money on slow manual quotations and tender responses
phases.workflow: Tender or enquiry in, priced quotation draft with a source behind every line, human approval, then send and track
phases.slice: One vertical template: quotation with per-line source references, a deterministic gate that blocks unsupported lines, and one approval screen
phases.revenue_impact: $3,000 deployment plus $500-2,000/month retainer; the audit's own first recommendation for fastest revenue
risks: Hallucinated prices in a document the buyer forwards (mitigate: no line without source_ref, gate blocks emission)
Portal bans from automation (mitigate: one tenant profile plus lease, already shipped)
Scope creep into a full ERP (mitigate: kill criteria below)
objectives: Cut quotation turnaround by an order of magnitude on one real workflow
Make every price traceable to a source or a named assumption
Bill at least one pilot through credits
tasks: Model quotation and quotation_line with source_kind and source_ref
Add a per-tenant quote_draft prompt template
Build the gate modelled on utils/blogQuality.js
Wire POST /capture to fill supplier-priced lines
Build the line-by-line approval screen with approver identity and timestamp
Attach the deposit through routes/mpesa.js and utils/scanPay.js
Run three pilots and instrument turnaround and edit counts

kpis.metric: Lines with a resolvable source or named assumption

exit_criteria: One pilot pays a second month without a new build request
kill_criteria: Pilots use the draft but will not pay for it: narrow to capture-only tender finding before writing another template

phases.name: Hands that transact, under lease and approval
phases.target_buyer: Existing pilots moving from document drafting to running follow-up and collecting money
phases.workflow: Accepted quotation, deposit collected, follow-up cadence, delivery confirmation, with every automated step attributable
phases.slice: One job-to-cash pipeline: three automatic steps and two hard human gates, each automatic step writing an automation_log row
phases.revenue_impact: Turns a one-off deployment into a visible retainer and creates the transaction surface
risks: Agent sending an unapproved price (mitigate: DB constraint plus test, not convention)
WhatsApp policy violations (mitigate: template-only sends and per-contact opt-out)
Browser identity bans (mitigate: one profile per tenant lease, fail-closed AGENT_API_KEY)
objectives: Trust the brain with a follow-up, not only a draft
tasks: Define the job-to-cash state machine and forbid amount-changing transitions without approval
Write automation_log rows for every automatic step with structured details
Implement the payment recovery sweep on the kernel payments module
Add and enforce the per-contact opt-out flag
Add npm run test:open-brain-pipeline covering approval, opt-out, attempt cap and logging
Instrument attempts, recoveries, recovered value and median recovery time

kpis.metric: Automatic steps producing an audit row
Price-bearing actions without an approval row
Agent run success rate on defined tasks

exit_criteria: A tenant renews because money came back and can point at the log row that proves it
kill_criteria: Recovery volume is too small to matter: stop automating and return to acquisition

phases.name: Licence the brain
phases.target_buyer: Agencies and consultancies that already sell to SMEs and want the engine, not the labour
phases.workflow: A new operator stands up an isolated brain for their own client in under one business day with proof and metering included
phases.slice: A licence kit: kernel package, migration set, isolation proof runner, evidence pack generator, metering config, one-day checklist
phases.revenue_impact: $10,000 licence anchor plus $500-2,000/month per client under the operator at software margins
risks: Becoming a bespoke consultancy again (mitigate: refuse licences that need repo write access)
Unreproducible operator environments (mitigate: the proof command is the first support question)
Key handling at the operator (mitigate: worker-bundle precedent, privileged half stays server-side)
objectives: Make a new isolated brain a checklist, not a project
Make exit as easy as entry and say so
tasks: Package alphadome-kernel as a versioned dependency with .env.local.example and one proof gate
Write docs/forge/OPEN_BRAIN_LICENCE_KIT.md
Add per-operator metering config from tiers and quota
Produce the per-tenant exit artefact (rows, audit trail, evidence refs)
Sign three licences and log time to first tenant
Publish an honest pricing table including exclusions

kpis.metric: Operator time to first live tenant
Clients with a delivered audit packet
Exit requests fulfilled without engineering work
Support tickets resolvable by the proof command

exit_criteria: An operator signs a second client without contacting us
kill_criteria: Every licence needs custom work: the product is the service, so raise the price, cap the clients and stop calling it a platform

horizons.name: The business twin
horizons.narration_beat: City digital twins and 30-day neighbourhood forecasts
horizons.translation: Per-tenant demand, pricing and cash simulation from the tenant's own order and quotation history, replayed over 90 days before a decision is enabled
entry_gate: At least 30 tenants with 6+ months of clean order data
Backtest beats a naive last-month baseline by 20% or more
Every simulated recommendation renders with its evidence inputs
refuse: Outputs that cannot be traced to tenant-owned data

horizons.name: The Open Brain Network and the portable tenant
horizons.narration_beat: AI passports plus Consensus 1 as a single merged global model
horizons.translation: Many isolated brains that verify each other's audit trails; a tenant can move operators without losing identity, credits or history. Federation, not merger
entry_gate: At least 3 independent operators on the kernel
Tenant export and import proven twice end to end
No single party can read all tenants
horizons.money: Network fee per verified tenant move
refuse: Any architecture with one global read path

horizons.name: The commerce edge (partners only)
horizons.translation: Tenant-premises device layer (kiosk, voice, payment, inventory) on partners' hardware and our brain, with an off switch the tenant controls
entry_gate: Software margin at 70% or better for four consecutive quarters
One vertical with proven unit economics
100 devices live in a single metro
Published MTBF and a field-failure process
refuse: Devices that move money without an approval row

horizons.name: Reskilling, not resignation
horizons.narration_beat: Universal basic income and universal basic learning credits
horizons.translation: A tenant academy that trains the humans whose tasks the brain is changing, paid for by the licence, with completion tracked against retained revenue
entry_gate: A named task measurably displaced inside a paying tenant
A completed curriculum with before-and-after task timings

refusals: General intelligence, consciousness or human-level capability claims
A companion or clone that denies being a machine
Autonomous money movement, price changes or refunds without an approval row
Health, aviation, weapons or safety-critical decision domains
Surveillance of a tenant's customers beyond the message they sent us
A metric without a kill criterion
A safety page whose claims a stranger cannot regenerate
